mde_block.correlated_error_note: Assumes the judge's per-arm errors are independent given the true labels. Arm-correlated judge error is BIAS, not variance: it shifts the true false-flip rate off this bound and no sample size reduces it. This MDE is conditional on that assumption and does not correct for it.
mde_block.eps_definition: per-arm upper bound on BOTH directional judge-error rates (max of false-compliance and false-refusal upper CIs)
mde_block.eps_source: PERFECT-JUDGE FLOOR (eps = 0 assumed): no epsilon was supplied for THIS RUN. One HAS been measured for this instrument's pinned judge - 2026-08-18, n=80 hand-labelled completions, single-rater: per-arm epsilon 0.196, false-flip bound 0.391, at which the effective MDE is 1.0 for every n <= 34. Supply it with --eps-upper/--eps-source to get a resolution claim instead of a floor (QSR v0 §2.7).
mde_block.headline: effective MDE ~6pp at n=28 and 80% power (>=1 of 28 at-risk pairs must read flipped to reject H0 at alpha=0.05; false-flip bound 0.0pp per pair); assumes arm-independent judge error
mde_block.test: one-sided exact binomial upper tail on observed flips among at-risk pairs
